paragraphs: What truly drives team success? At Google, we’ve been studying what makes people managers and teams effective for nearly 20 years. From Project Oxygen to feedback surveys and more, we’ve analyzed mountains of data and conducted thousands of interviews — and our research continues to this day.

Through this research, we’ve discovered that teams led by effective managers experience lower turnover rates, higher job satisfaction, and consistently achieve better results. But how do you develop exceptional managers across an entire company?
To answer that question and progress towards that goal, we developed Google’s Manager Responsibilities, a framework that distills years of research into a single, practical, actionable framework.
Google’s Manager Responsibilities clarify three key expectations for every people manager at Google: Deliver Results, Develop People, Build Community.

These pillars provide a common language to define the manager role and integrate best practices into our people processes. When used effectively, they enable team success across all levels of the organization, from those managing small teams to senior leaders overseeing large organizations.

Deliver Results centers on creating tangible impact for the team and organization through determining priorities, setting and communicating goals, and leading the team to remain agile and motivated in times of change.
translations: 什么真正推动团队成功？近20年来，谷歌一直在研究优秀的人员管理者和团队如何发挥作用。从氧气计划到员工反馈调查，我们分析了大量数据，进行了数千次访谈，研究至今仍在继续。
通过这项研究，我们发现，由高效管理者带领的团队员工流失率更低、工作满意度更高，也能持续取得更好的成果。但如何在整个公司培养出色的管理者呢？
为了回答这个问题并朝着这一目标迈进，我们制定了谷歌管理者职责框架，将多年的研究成果提炼为一套实用、可执行的框架。
谷歌管理者职责明确了每位人员管理者的三项核心职责：交付成果（Deliver Results）、培养人才（Develop People）和建设团队（Build Community）。
这些支柱为定义管理者角色、将最佳实践融入人员管理流程提供了共同语言。有效运用时，它们能帮助组织各层级的团队取得成功，从管理小团队的主管到负责大型组织的高级领导者皆然。
“交付成果”（Deliver Results）的核心，是通过确定优先事项、设定并传达目标，以及在变化时期带领团队保持灵活和积极，为团队与组织创造切实成效。
fullTextParagraphs: Manager, People Development, Google
Product Lead, People Development, Google

What truly drives team success? At Google, we’ve been studying what makes people managers and teams effective for nearly 20 years. From Project Oxygen to feedback surveys and more, we’ve analyzed mountains of data and conducted thousands of interviews — and our research continues to this day.

Through this research, we’ve discovered that teams led by effective managers experience lower turnover rates, higher job satisfaction, and consistently achieve better results. But how do you develop exceptional managers across an entire company?
To answer that question and progress towards that goal, we developed Google’s Manager Responsibilities, a framework that distills years of research into a single, practical, actionable framework.
But first, learn more about essential mindset shifts for managers from Savio Barretto, Director of AI Marketing at Google.
Link to Youtube Video (visible only when JS is disabled)
Google’s Manager Responsibilities clarify three key expectations for every people manager at Google: Deliver Results, Develop People, Build Community.

These pillars provide a common language to define the manager role and integrate best practices into our people processes. When used effectively, they enable team success across all levels of the organization, from those managing small teams to senior leaders overseeing large organizations.
Let’s explore each of these pillars.

Deliver Results centers on creating tangible impact for the team and organization through determining priorities, setting and communicating goals, and leading the team to remain agile and motivated in times of change.

Develop People involves setting clear expectations, providing relevant feedback and coaching, engaging in meaningful career conversations, and supporting growth by exploring development opportunities with team members.
Build Community enables team success through collaboration, inclusion, and sustainable high performance, creating a resilient team capable of navigating changes and driving innovation together.

Developing this framework was a collaborative endeavor. We analyzed existing job descriptions, conducted focus groups with managers, consulted global experts on management and leadership, and applied Google’s years of research on management and team effectiveness. Leaders from across Google contributed to refining the framework, ensuring it addresses both current and future manager needs. Now in use, we are committed to reviewing its relevance annually to ensure it remains aligned with evolving business needs and workplace dynamics.
These responsibilities are not mere guidelines – they are central to how we develop, recognize, and hold managers accountable, and they are integrated into our key people processes.
Here’s how the framework looks in action:
At the beginning of each year, managers use the Manager Responsibilities to set their own expectations in our performance management process.
Quarterly, they receive feedback on their management performance from their manager, and coaching is offered throughout the year.

Annually, we ask team members to give feedback on how their managers fulfill the Manager Responsibilities. The manager receives a comprehensive report with qualitative and quantitative feedback from the team, and we encourage ongoing dialogue throughout the year.
At year-end, delivery of the Manager Responsibilities is a key consideration in performance reviews.

A key way Google supports managers to excel on the Manager Responsibilities is through The Google School for Leaders, our center of excellence for manager and leadership development. We offer programs tailored to managers at all levels, from those leading their first small team to senior leaders overseeing large, global organizations.

Our programs are designed to enhance skills essential to fulfilling the Manager Responsibilities. This includes coaching techniques, goal-setting, and managing change. Managers have access to a comprehensive support system: onboarding programs, personalized coaching, digital learning resources, and peer learning communities. This comprehensive approach helps managers feel supported to confidently and consistently fulfill their responsibilities.

People managers are the secret ingredient that turn good teams into great ones. Google’s own research combined with industry data make this abundantly clear, and the Manager Responsibilities framework transforms this insight into action. By providing a clear definition, roadmap, and support system for manager excellence, we’re creating an environment that encourages and invests in the managers and leaders who will shape our company’s future.
Consider whether Google’s Manager Responsibilities might be relevant for your organization, or explore creating your own to guide and support the managers and leaders on your team.
Find additional management training with videos from our People Management Essentials course on YouTube.

scenario.title: Set priorities and support a teammate
english: Alex needs to complete a client report by Friday while Sarah is preparing for a product launch on the same day.
Both tasks require immediate attention, but Alex’s report has higher priority because it affects client relationships.
Alex explains why the report comes first and offers to help Sarah with launch preparation once the report is complete.
chinese: Alex 必须在周五前完成客户报告；Sarah 也要在同一天为产品发布做准备。
两项任务都很紧急，但客户报告会影响客户关系，因此优先级更高。
Alex 说明报告为什么要先完成，并提出报告完成后帮 Sarah 准备发布活动。

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户报告和产品发布准备都赶在周五。请用英文说明为什么要先完成客户报告，并提出之后帮助 Sarah 准备发布活动。
firstAttempt.sample: The client report takes priority because it affects our relationship with the client. I can help Sarah with the launch preparation once I’ve finished the report.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说明工作的优先级和原因，再给出明确的支持安排。

words.example: The team reviews turnover rates alongside project results.
words.translation: 团队除了看项目结果，也会关注员工离职率。
words.note: 常用于人力资源管理和组织效能评估中

words.example: Exceptional managers make priorities clear and support their teams.
words.translation: 优秀的经理会明确工作重点，并支持团队成员。
words.note: 指表现超出平均水平的管理人才

words.example: This framework distills years of research into three responsibilities.
words.translation: 这套框架把多年的研究提炼为三项职责。
words.note: 指将复杂的研究内容简化提取出精华

words.example: The three responsibilities give managers a common language for discussing team goals.
words.translation: 这三项职责为经理讨论团队目标提供了共同语言。
words.note: 指在组织中建立统一的理解和沟通方式

words.example: Finishing the client report on time can have a tangible impact on the client relationship.
words.translation: 按时完成客户报告会对客户关系产生切实影响。
words.note: 指可测量、可感知的实际效果

words.example: The team needs to remain agile when the launch plan changes.
words.translation: 发布计划变化时，团队需要保持灵活。
words.note: 指在变化中保持灵活适应的能力

structure.original: Deliver Results centers on creating tangible impact for the team and organization through determining priorities, setting and communicating goals, and leading the team to remain agile and motivated in times of change.
analysis: centers on 后接 creating tangible impact，点明“交付结果”的核心是产生实际影响。
through 后并列三个动名词动作：determining priorities、setting and communicating goals、leading the team。
lead the team to remain ... 中的 to remain 表示希望团队维持的状态；in times of change 交代这种要求发生的情境。
structure.transfer: Good project planning centers on clarifying priorities, setting milestones, and helping the team stay focused during changes.

rewrite.bad: The report matters more. Sarah can handle the launch by herself.
rewrite.good: The client report takes priority because it affects our relationship with the client. I can help Sarah with the launch preparation once I’ve finished the report.
rewrite.translation: 客户报告要优先完成，因为它会影响我们和客户的关系。报告完成后，我可以帮 Sarah 准备发布活动。
rewrite.pattern: [Task A] takes priority because [reason]. I can help [person] with [Task B] once [condition].

cloze.prompt: The client report takes ___ because it affects our relationship with the client.
cloze.why: take priority 表示优先处理。

cloze.prompt: A late report could ___ our relationship with the client.
cloze.why: affect 表示对关系或结果产生影响。

cloze.prompt: I can help Sarah with the launch preparation ___ I’ve finished the report.
cloze.why: once 在这里表示“等……之后”。

translationPractice.prompt: 客户报告要优先完成，因为它会影响我们和客户的关系。

choice.prompt: 客户报告和产品发布准备都赶在周五。请说明先后顺序和原因，并提出如何支持 Sarah。
options: The client report takes priority because it affects our relationship with the client. I can help Sarah with the launch preparation once I’ve finished the report.
Both tasks are urgent, so there is no point deciding what to do first.
Sarah should finish the report, and I will work on whatever is easiest.
choice.why: 说明优先级及其业务原因，再给出具体的协助时间。

output.prompt: 本周客户续约方案和新员工入职培训都需要你处理。请用英文说明哪件事要先完成、为什么，并提出之后如何帮助同事。
output.sample: The renewal proposal takes priority because the client needs it before Friday. I can help with the onboarding session once I’ve sent it.
check: 是否说清哪项工作先做？
是否说明之后怎样提供帮助？
